problem.passage:
A marine biologist studied the diving behavior of six leatherback sea turtles fitted with satellite tags off the coast of Costa Rica. For each turtle, the researcher recorded the maximum dive depth (in meters) and the average dive duration (in minutes) over a two-month tracking period.

Turtle | Maximum Dive Depth (meters) | Average Dive Duration (minutes)
T1 | 320 | 45
T2 | 410 | 52
T3 | 287 | 38
T4 | 512 | 60
T5 | 398 | 48
T6 | 455 | 55

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement: "Among the six tracked turtles, the one with the greatest maximum dive depth was ______"?
problem.stimulus:
A marine biologist studied the diving behavior of six leatherback sea turtles fitted with satellite tags off the coast of Costa Rica. For each turtle, the researcher recorded the maximum dive depth (in meters) and the average dive duration (in minutes) over a two-month tracking period.

Turtle | Maximum Dive Depth (meters) | Average Dive Duration (minutes)
T1 | 320 | 45
T2 | 410 | 52
T3 | 287 | 38
T4 | 512 | 60
T5 | 398 | 48
T6 | 455 | 55
problem.question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement: "Among the six tracked turtles, the one with the greatest maximum dive depth was ______"?
options: T3, which reached a maximum dive depth of 287 meters
T4, which reached a maximum dive depth of 512 meters
T6, which reached a maximum dive depth of 455 meters
T2, which reached a maximum dive depth of 410 meters
problem.explanation: 표에서 Maximum Dive Depth (meters) 열의 값을 모두 비교하면 T4의 512미터가 가장 크므로 정답은 B번이다.
problem.evidenceSpan: Row: T4, Column: Maximum Dive Depth (meters) = 512
problem.answerRationale: B의 512미터는 표에서 Maximum Dive Depth (meters) 열의 최댓값이며 T4 행의 실제 값과 일치한다.

difficultyReasons: 표에서 한 열(최대 잠수 깊이)만 비교하면 되는 1단계 추론
6개 값 중 최댓값을 찾는 단순 비교 작업
오답들이 실제 표 값이라 완전히 무관하지 않지만 크기 비교만 하면 쉽게 배제 가능
별도의 계산이나 복합적 해석이 필요 없음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 표에 실제로 존재하는 값이며 형식이 정답과 동일하다
455m은 두 번째로 큰 값으로 최댓값에 근접해 대충 훑어보면 헷갈릴 수 있다
410m 역시 표에 있는 값으로 그럴듯해 보인다
